trapmat savior.bio: TRAPMAT SAVIOR is a Haiti-born, Montreal-based rapper whose work blends Quebec rap with melodic and experimental hip-hop influences. After moving to Montreal, he developed a distinctive style within the city's francophone scene and has been highlighted among emerging Quebec rap artists. Northern Dial carries TRAPMAT SAVIOR as part of its contemporary Montreal hip-hop catalogue.

thera11n.bio: TheRa11n is a Winnipeg-born Plains Cree artist whose music combines hip-hop with Indigenous musical and cultural influences. His work has been described through a powwow-step approach that connects contemporary production with his Plains Cree identity. Northern Dial carries TheRa11n as part of its Indigenous Canadian hip-hop catalogue.

uss.bio: USS, short for Ubiquitous Synergy Seeker, is a Canadian alternative dance duo formed in Toronto by Ashley Buchholz and Jason 'Human Kebab' Parsons. The group built a national following by combining rock, electronic production, turntablism and high-energy live performance. Northern Dial carries USS as part of its modern Canadian alternative catalogue.

anthony bezel.bio: Anthony Bezel is a Toronto-area artist and producer working across hip-hop and contemporary R&B. Based in Mississauga and active within the Greater Toronto Area, he has released solo music and collaborations with artists from the region's independent scene. Northern Dial carries Anthony Bezel as part of its GTA hip-hop catalogue.

vt.bio: VT is a Montreal rapper associated with Saint-Leonard whose music sits within Quebec's contemporary street-rap scene. His French-language catalogue reflects Montreal's francophone hip-hop culture and the city's newer independent rap movement. Northern Dial carries VT as part of its Montreal hip-hop catalogue.
